inspector.title: Original cardiac walls, semilunar cusps and papillary source objects
inspector.caption: Fourteen original curated objects retain all 72,572 source triangles. LA and RA walls are separately labelled; the ventricular wall is one combined source object, not independently split LV/RV walls. Its eight components, seven nonmanifold edges and three zero-area faces remain unmodified and unapproved. Annuli, chordae, pericardium, patient-matched anatomy and function remain absent or unverified.
inspector.attribution: BodyParts3D, Copyright 2008 Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS). Original 4.3 source positions, normals and ordered faces retained with measured float32 display precision. Display adaptation remains CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan.

inspector.title: Original manual-annotation and model-prediction CT comparisons
inspector.caption: All 6,061 original paired PNGs in eight methods-defined categories remain available. Green is the paper's manual annotation and red its model prediction; neither is a current-patient finding or independent clinical approval. These published 512 by 256 comparisons do not provide raw CT values, calibrated measurements, physical slice spacing or 3D masks. Three additional archive categories with unverified definitions are excluded.
inspector.attribution: Baskaran L and colleagues (2020). Automatic segmentation of multiple cardiovascular structures from cardiac computed tomography angiography images using deep learning. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0232573; dataset DOI 10.5061/dryad.9s4mw6mc9. CC0 1.0 source PNGs unchanged.
